words.sourceMeaning: 인출 연습 (이미 배운 정보를 기억에서 꺼내는 연습. 답을 다시 읽는 복습과 구별)

meanings.en: A study method in which you try to recall information from memory.
meanings.wrongEn: A method of storing old documents in a safe place.

words.sourceMeaning: 개념도 (여러 개념 사이의 관계를 연결하여 나타낸 그림)

meanings.en: A diagram that shows the relationships between different ideas.
meanings.wrongEn: A drawing that shows the streets of a city.

words.sourceMeaning: ~와는 달리, ~와 대조적으로 (이 글에서는 기억해 내려는 노력과 단순 반복을 대조)

meanings.wrongEn: Because of or as a result of something.

words.sourceMeaning: 반복하여 되뇌다, 연습하다 (이 글에서는 정보를 단순히 반복하는 것)

meanings.en: To repeat information or practice something again and again.
meanings.wrongEn: To make a formal complaint to a manager.

words.sourceMeaning: 유발하다, 촉발하다 (명사로는 ‘방아쇠’, 여기서는 어떤 과정을 시작하게 한다는 뜻의 동사)

meanings.en: To cause something to start or happen.
meanings.wrongEn: To stop something from growing any further.

words.sourceMeaning: 재공고화 (떠올린 기억이 다시 안정된 상태로 굳어지는 과정. consolidation은 ‘공고화’)

meanings.en: The process by which a recalled memory becomes stable and fixed again.
meanings.wrongEn: The process of dividing a company into smaller parts.

words.sourceMeaning: 제안하다 (It has been proposed that은 '~라는 설명이 제시되어 왔다')

meanings.en: To put forward an idea or explanation for others to consider.
meanings.wrongEn: To refuse to take part in a discussion.
